component: MIME preference reads and emitter state

quotes.text:
- name: mail.show_headers
  type: int32_t
  value: 1
  mirror: always

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The message-display migration declares always-mirrored preferences, but callers still choose when to read them. The base emitter copies mail_show_headers at construction and later filters headers through mHeaderDisplayType. The HTML emitter reads mail_show_headers for each BroadcastHeaders call. Display-stream setup copies attachment, charset and HTML options into stream state. An always-mirrored declaration alone does not refresh those already-copied fields.
title: Static MIME preferences keep the consumer lifetime of copied header and stream state
